--- import type { ImageMetadata } from "astro" import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card" import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon" import { Rating } from "@/components/ui/rating" import { Section, SectionContainer, SectionDescription, SectionTitle, } from "@/components/ui/section" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section"> & { title?: string description?: string reviews: { rating: number quote: string image?: ImageMetadata initials: string name: string role: string }[] } const { class: className, title, description, reviews, ...props } = Astro.props ---
{ (title || description) && ( {title && {title}} {description && ( {description} )} ) }
{ reviews.map((item) => (

{item.quote}

{item.initials}

{item.name}

{item.role}

 )) }
